title: Enterprise Connectivity: tax classification
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs tax classification for service charge, credit, upward adjustment.

## Policy clause 1
The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Policy clause 2
Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax treatment fractions.

## Policy clause 3
Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal places and rounding convention.

## Policy clause 4
For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment.

## Policy clause 5
Tax credits have negative tax component; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax component.

## Policy clause 6
Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt.

## Superseded scope 7
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for net transfer invoice; separate statutory tax. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.

## Policy clause 8
A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Evidence condition 1
For service charge, credit, upward adjustment, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. The evidence consists of contract identifier, tax-review approval, tax treatment. Correlate the same contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Points of judgement
A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the tax treatment fractions, monetary decimal places, rounding convention used by this rule.
